Hi everyone! I am a high school student from Vietnam who is interested in science, technology, space exploration, and artificial intelligence. I enjoy learning new things, solving problems, and developing creative ideas.

I am eager to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge to learn from others, explore NASA's resources, and work together to create innovative solutions to real-world problems.I welcome anyone who is motivated, open-minded, and excited to learn together! dưới 500 từ
